structural_constraints: S1 [单模态开环局限 Open-Loop Visual Limitation]：Relying solely on RGB-D point clouds leaves manipulation policies vulnerable to self-occlusion by the robot gripper during fine-grained contact.

S4 [Sim-to-Real 自适应机制 Sim-to-Real Adaptation]：During physical deployment, a lightweight history adapter infers latent friction and payload parameters online, bridging the sim-to-real dynamics gap without policy fine-tuning.

communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想阐述具身智能机器人策略（Embodied Policy）如何融合视觉、本体感觉（Proprioception）或触觉，并克服仿真到真实硬件的动力学差距（Sim-to-Real Gap）。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：TOEFL_Integrated 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT16 (托福综合写作（Integrated Writing）满分范文：自主无人机配送能否取代城市货车（阅读三论点 vs. 听力逐点反驳）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP31 -> BP27 -> BP28`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: When the robot hand blocks the camera, the robot cannot see the object clearly. So we add force sensors and joint angles. Also, we predict multiple steps of actions and use an adapter to transfer from simulation to the real robot.
structural_constraints: S1 [单模态开环局限 Open-Loop Visual Limitation]：Relying solely on RGB-D point clouds leaves manipulation policies vulnerable to self-occlusion by the robot gripper during fine-grained contact.

S2 [多模态时空对齐 Multi-Modal Alignment]：To maintain state observability during contact, our encoder aligns asynchronous 30 Hz visual tokens with 500 Hz joint proprioception and wrist force-torque histories.

S3 [动作块预测与平滑执行 Action Chunking & Temporal Ensembling]：Rather than predicting single-step torques prone to jitter, the policy outputs overlapping $K$-step SE(3) end-effector action chunks smoothed via exponential temporal ensembling.

S4 [Sim-to-Real 自适应机制 Sim-to-Real Adaptation]：During physical deployment, a lightweight history adapter infers latent friction and payload parameters online, bridging the sim-to-real dynamics gap without policy fine-tuning.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: Tech Talk / Conference Oral / 组会开场逐字稿（Slide 1–2）
domain_context: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想作为顶会 Oral Presentation、组会汇报或博士面试 PPT 第一页的开场白：在 45–60 秒内不用任何晦涩公式，让全场听众立刻听懂“我们为什么要做这件事、现有方法到底卡在哪”。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP41` 与全文样板 `FT16` 的后半部分（`BP32`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: We did comprehensive experiments on many datasets. The results show that our model beats all baselines by a large margin and is very fast.
structural_constraints: S1 [场景直觉切入 Concrete Scenario Hook]：Good morning everyone. Imagine deploying a humanoid robot to assemble flexible cables on a moving factory line—or forecasting grid load when a storm hits.
S2 [反直觉痛点设问 Counter-intuitive Breakdown]：Standard deep models perform remarkably well when conditions stay calm, yet why do they fail abruptly the moment contact dynamics or weather patterns shift?
S3 [一针见血揭晓答案 Crisp Root Cause]：The culprit is a hidden stationarity assumption baked into standard attention layers.
S4 [亮出今日主旨 Talk Roadmap]：In this talk, I will show how our framework, [Model Name], breaks this bottleneck and achieves [Key Metric Gain] in real-time deployment.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
